title: Overnight Laundry Finish Notification Gap
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:washer finish_window="overnight"
| stats max(_time) as last_finish, avg(notification_lag_minutes) as avg_notification_lag by machine_name
| eval hours_since_last_finish=round((now()-last_finish)/3600,1)
| sort - avg_notification_lag
description: Measures how quickly overnight washer-cycle completions are surfaced back to you as notifications.
value: The operational goal is simple: do not leave wet laundry stewing in the drum for hours by accident.
implementation: Forward ThinQ cycle completion events and the time the completion notice fired, then compare the lag.
visualization: Table of machines with average completion-notification lag.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks whether overnight laundry finishes are getting noticed quickly instead of sitting forgotten.
